scope: Selected base_types, lib_algebra and lib_array modules, using the pinned revision immediately before the upstream FPM test suite introduced source symlinks. Nine checksum-guarded edits bring lib_array exactly to upstream commit 844611933cba06d71490033e68b355f6f0ff704f, retaining its integration-limit, descending histogram-bin and precision fixes. The other selected modules are unchanged. The ordinary archive policy remains unchanged. A synthetic FPM wrapper uses the already generated Fortran sources, not the Python templates. The checked consumer integrates the affine function 2*x+1 on [0,1], checks linear interpolation at an interior off-grid point, and solves x**2-5*x+6 against the exact roots 2 and 3. Additional checks cover integration limits outside the tabulated range, descending histogram bins and bin-center precision; the expanded example fails with the older unpatched array module and passes with the upstream fixes. GAMS F1 denotes the quadratic solver, not a general iterative root finder. Random sampling, statistics, geometry, HDF5/FITS bindings and other modules are not selected; the example does not validate every routine in the included modules.

upstream_fixes.note: After normalized-LF checksum-guarded edits, the complete selected lib_array module equals this upstream version. base_types and lib_algebra already match the newer commit.
